question:
VIDEO QUESTION from the owner of PaperTrades.AI. NOT a trading turn.

Owner, Nov 13: "generate 3 options with the other models so I can pick commercial 1, 2 or 3. Again this is for the Discord channel. Make it look good and unique. We're going to be BOOSTING this post a lot to grow the Discord channel."
So: three distinct vertical commercials for the free PaperTrades.AI Discord, one of which gets paid boosting (Instagram/Facebook, YouTube, X). The goal of every option: people JOIN THE DISCORD.

OPTION 1 (Claude, already made, 39 s; PICTURE 1 shows its frames): a tour. Robots + live totals -> the website on a phone (scroll, tap a trade: the AI's reason + Transaction ID) -> peer grades -> the real Discord channel list -> the real alert setup (pick headlines, pick Gemini -> Crypto, a ping) -> "change it any time: server name -> Channels & Roles" -> end card (logo, "Free Discord, link in description", like and subscribe). The phone frame is being redrawn as a slim modern phone.

YOUR JOB: write ONE new option, different from Option 1 and from each other:
- If you are GEMINI, write OPTION 2: it must open on a phone and its pings (the feeling of the three AIs' moves arriving in your pocket, and choosing which ones ping you).
- If you are CHATGPT, write OPTION 3: it must lead with the three AIs as rival characters ("pick your AI": follow Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT in the race of your choice).
Within that, the idea is yours. Make it look premium and unique, never "AI slop".

WHAT EXISTS (use only these; everything shown must be real):
A. Our three robot mascots, animated (drop in, blink, talk; Claude orange, Gemini blue, ChatGPT white; identical shapes).
B. The website filmed at phone size: the home page (hero "Which AI makes the most (pretend) money?", overall standings, race cards), a trade's story panel (Gemini's C$35,000 Bitcoin buy, its own reason, Transaction ID G-CRY-028), race standings.
C. Real screenshots of our Discord (PICTURE 2): the channel list (START HERE, HEADLINES #daily-results #lead-changes #announcements #big-moments, LIVE #live-trades, RACES: 12 channels, COMMUNITY #general #who-wins), Channels & Roles "Which headlines should ping you?" (Daily results, Lead changes, Big moments, Season news) and "Gemini: which races should ping you?" (12 races; same for Claude and ChatGPT), a real #live-trades post with the move card image.
D. The real move cards the bot posts (price, size, time, the AI's reason), for any real move.
E. Real numbers (Nov 13 morning): total profit Gemini +C$35,367, Claude -C$14,305, ChatGPT -C$17,576 (pretend money, 10 races, Oct 28 to Nov 28). Peer grades: each AI grades the others' moves before the result is known.
F. A drawn phone lock screen / notification banners (generic, no Apple or Discord UI copies) showing real moves.
G. Our logo, our own synthesized music and sounds, AI voices (a narrator + one voice per AI), burned-in captions.
RULES: 9:16; the first 1.5 s must hook with the sound off; no sports odds or betting (paid ad review); no claims about real people or companies; Discord's logo only as a small "Join on Discord" badge, never as our brand; end card says pretend money, not advice; everything inside the safe zone.

REPLY with ONLY JSON:
{"option": "2 or 3", "title": "...", "length_s": 20-35, "why_it_converts": "one line",
 "hook": {"on_screen": "...", "voice": "..."},
 "scenes": [{"s": "0-3", "visual": "what we see, using A-G", "voice_who": "narrator|claude|gemini|chatgpt|none", "voice": "the exact line (short)", "caption": "the burned-in words"}],
 "end_card": "...", "music_mood": "...",
 "option1_for_boosting": "AGREE it's fine as is / AMEND: what to cut or change for a paid boost (one line)",
 "boost_tip": "one line: the single most important thing for this to work as a paid boost"}
Keep the voice lines short and natural (total under 75 words).
